summary: Beauty By Doctor has a doctor led brand, press features and a treatment quiz. Typos and dead links on the main menu, and no patient proof, weaken a clinic that sells medical credibility.

findings.problem: Typos on the page include physcian, Cosmentic Injectables Boom, fro women only and Sededation, and a double space in Dr  Phoebe. A title reads Lenisna vs Rejuran... Introduction.
findings.cost: A doctor led clinic sells care and accuracy. Typos in headlines make patients question both.
findings.fix: A proofread build with consistent, clean headlines.

findings.problem: The Treatments and Concern menu items link to # or javascript:void(0), so they do not go anywhere. Some Book Now buttons have no link.
findings.cost: A patient who clicks Treatments and sees nothing leaves, and a Book Now that does nothing loses a booking.
findings.fix: Working menus and every Book Now linked to booking.

findings.problem: No patient reviews or before and after galleries appear, and press features are mostly about the doctor, not patient results.
findings.cost: Press builds authority, but injectable patients decide on results they can see.
findings.fix: Captioned results with consent and verified patient reviews.

findings.problem: Mega menus repeat long treatment and concern lists several times, with some concerns listed twice. Stray markup fragments appear in press blurbs. There is no contact form or chat.
findings.cost: A crowded menu slows visitors, and stray markup looks unfinished. Patients with a question have nowhere to ask.
findings.fix: A simpler menu, clean blurbs and a short contact form with chat.

redesign: A proof first homepage with captioned results, reviews and press beside every booking button.
A simple menu, working links and one clear booking path.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like anti wrinkle injections Bondi Junction and Sydney cosmetic doctor.
